facts.claim: Only journal.assess accepting the exact open incident revision writes assessment and assessed audit atomically; it rejects changed or already-current incidents. Tool return is accepted:true/reason:assessment_recorded. Queue acknowledgement or chat text is not assessment.

Watchdog owns independent sqlite database with WAL and synchronous FULL. Delivery id, exact observation/revision and text are reserved before send; sent acknowledgement waits AgentDelivery Session flush.

Watchdog config.model is optional provider/model/reasoningEffort. initializeRoleModel resolves and appends model/selection only on a new unselected Session, without the operation that changes global default. Reusing a case stateDir may preserve its earlier route.

SupervisionClient fetches authenticated GET /orchestrator/api/supervision at strictly http://127.0.0.1:<port>, reads tokenFile, refuses redirects, bounds one page to 1MiB, validates SnapshotSchema. POST /intervene is the only command.

Actual monitor polls independently while model busy, cancels after assessmentTimeoutMs, latches fixed model error, sends one delivery per poll, and journal limits to three deliveries per task/review cycle. Fresh accepted assessment clears modelError; enqueue, idle or turn end do not.

Loop buildRequest stamps exact Session id into frozen GenerateOptions.sessionId; llm/stream is public waterfall receiving immutable loop request and next async iterator. Counter before next measures an admitted model stream attempt, not proof of network dispatch/billing.

Usage chunk is {type:usage,usage:{inputTokens,outputTokens,totalTokens?,cacheReadTokens?,cacheWriteTokens?,reasoningTokens?}}. Adapter emits usage before finish, and assembler retains last usage. Missing usage is unknown, not zero. Preserve fields separately; reasoning/cache are not unconditional addends to total.

Successful or interrupted visible output settles assistant/message with optional usage; failures/retries/no-visible canceled output settle assistant/attempt with compact stream. Durable stream raw chunk records include usage and finish; assistant-stream helpers can inspect last usage without saving text. Do not add Session usage and llm/stream usage together.

session/event is post-commit fire-and-forget, with exact Session object and sequenced typed event. turn/end carries turn and reason kind completed|aborted|blocked|error|max-tokens|interrupted|forked. Completed can follow an empty turn, and whenIdle is not disk flush; explicitly await Session persistence flush before claiming stored turn completion.

agent/error provides exact Agent, turn, step and verbatim unknown error, emitted before turn/end. Do not persist raw error or turn error.message; retain event kind and fixed whitelisted code only. Assessment accepted before a later failure remains recorded, so retain assessmentOutcome and turnOutcome separately.

Durable Session tool/call event carries turn,step,callId,name,arguments. AgentLoop appends it before scheduler.prepare and guards, so it includes denied/unknown requests. Calls skipped after cancel also get synthetic call/result pairs. Count whitelisted names plus other only; this measures model-requested tools, not execution. tools/execute misses guard-denied requests.

llm-pi-ai provider config names apiKeyEnv as credential reference plus api/baseURL/models/compat/retryPolicy. Adapter resolves explicit reference via ctx.credentials.resolve or launch environment; absent reference fails instead of silently falling back. Credential service describe exposes presence metadata without resolving value.

Harness llm-retry requests a new stream attempt after error; DSH pi-ai passes maxRetries:0 and its OpenAI client SDK/request helper also receives zero, so this selected route does not hide an SDK retry loop. No statement about unexamined adapters, provider infrastructure or network attempts before stream admission.

Main UsageRuntime attributes coordinator and worker lineage; the independently deployed watchdog is outside that Store and main runtime. A scoped evaluation stream observer can reuse the public hook pattern without instantiating the main accounting system.

unknowns: No real model evaluation run here; diagnosis quality, token costs, provider availability and credential presence are unverified.
Model-call admission count is not provider billing, HTTP dispatch, or cost proof. Metadata/discovery/credential operations are outside the stream metrics.
Case labels and pass criteria require versioned product review; blocked/stalled/drift cannot be assumed from clock silence alone.
Main app profile and private key location were intentionally not inspected.
Live evaluation spend, route selection and credential source must be explicitly configured; provider configuration alone is not authorization for paid evaluation.
